candidate_workaround: Split the count search and Git status inspection into separate bounded probes, then continue only after each returns explicitly.
failure_signature: A combined read-only count search and whole-worktree status probe exceeded its short wrapper timeout before returning output; it made no repository change and received zero inspection credit.
recurrence_guard: Do not combine recursive repository inspection with whole-worktree status inside one short timeout wrapper on a large Windows tree.
rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness with zero credit, and leave all external and protected-gate state unchanged.
scope_boundary: Same-owner skill initialization recovery only; not independent reproduction or broader assurance.
title: Bounded recovery for combined_count_and_status_probe_timeout
